videos.title: Generator Operation: Magnetic Field, Frequency, Load, Governor and AVR
videos.scope: Wound-rotor magnetic field and induced stator voltage; pole pairs and speed/frequency; resistive loading before controls; governor torque/fuel response to active-load steps; AVR field response and terminal-voltage recovery. The physical system precedes its controls; no machine-design calculations or MATLAB programming is required.
